messages:
harry_partnerships: FYI CloudAnchor just provisioned 'Balearic' region in their marketplace sandbox. Need to coordinate quotas, KMS flow, and a partner-ready announcement timeline.
sana_partner_ops: Nice. They advertised 12 vA100-equivalents and 30 T4 spots. Marketplace listing shows "pending entitlement" for rwd-bal-1.
jake_sales: We've got inbound requests from two small ISVs asking for dedicated pools. Do we have a recommended min commit?
rachel_eng: For predictable latency under 99th pct SLA, recommend starting 8 reserved GPUs for core customers + autoscale burst to spots. Also need driver/cuda matrix validated on their images.
omar_infra: I'll raise the quota request now. @proc-bot please open partner entitlement ticket with payload: {product: "redwood-balearic", sku: "rwd-bal-1", units: 10, region: "balearic"}
proc-bot: Ticket PA-9123 created with CloudAnchor partner ops. Estimated review: 72 hours. Link: https://tickets.internal/PA-9123
sana_partner_ops: CloudAnchor requires a signed Marketplace Addendum and an export controls checklist before GA. @lisa_legal can you review the addendum? Link: https://go/redwood/legal/cloudanchor-addendum-balearic
lisa_legal: On it. Will review for encryption/KMS terms and export control flags. Expect notes by EOD + a redline.
jake_sales: Marketing wants partner logo clearance and partner quote by 2026-05-20 for a joint PR. Can partnerships confirm?
harry_partnerships: I'll ask CloudAnchor for a drafted quote and logo assets during the kickoff call. Propose timeline: sandbox tests complete by 2026-05-05, perf certs by 2026-05-12, addendum signed by 2026-05-15, GA 2026-06-01. Thoughts?
rachel_eng: Timeline sounds tight but doable if infra runs perf matrix asap. I need to run 256/512 token perf with batch sizes [1,8,32]. @omar_infra please run on their a10g-equivalent.
omar_infra: Scheduling perf runs tomorrow 03:00 PT. Will post logs to #eng-runtime and attach a short summary here.
sana_partner_ops: SI partner (NorthStar Systems) requested a provisioning webhook and a scoped service account. They need an OAuth sample and webhook schema. @harry_partnerships can you share the API stub?
harry_partnerships: Shared stub: https://go/redwood/api/stubs/balearic-provision.json. Ask SI to confirm scopes required by Mon.
lisa_legal: Also note: any co-branded announcement requires explicit partner approval on the PR copy and the brand usage guide. I'll add that to the checklist.
jake_sales: I'll coordinate enablement sessions with partner CS week of 2026-05-18. Need a product FAQ and short runbook for common provisioning failures.
harry_partnerships: Quick checklist for the call:
 - Marketplace Addendum review (Legal)
 - Entitlement ticket PA-9123 status (Proc-bot)
 - Quota provisioning timeline (Infra)
 - Perf runs and smoke tests (Eng)
 - SI provisioning hooks + OAuth scopes (Partnerships)
 - Marketing assets & PR approval (Sales/Marketing)
Call Wed 09:00 PT to align?
sana_partner_ops: Confirmed Wed 09:00 PT. I'll send invites and include CloudAnchor ops and NorthStar Systems.
harry_partnerships: Thanks all. Drop any escalations here before the call. :+1:
